name: Reckoning at the abacus school
blurb: Arabic numerals, double entry, and how a Florentine actually makes money from a bill of exchange.
unlocks: Forge a bill on a Medici factor

name: Cipher, privately taught
blurb: Substitution, nulls and a key word. Claes broke codes for fun; the rest of Bruges pays a tutor.
unlocks: Read a cipher letter that is not yours

name: Tuscan and Venetian
blurb: The language of the counting houses, and the difference between a Florentine and a Venetian insult.

name: Seamanship with a Flanders galley master
blurb: Tides, rutters and the Sluys channel. Your journeys are shorter and you know how to stow more.

name: Swordsmanship under Astorre
blurb: Astorre teaches as he fights: briefly and without mercy. Every yard is worth more afterwards.

name: Law at Louvain
blurb: Gregorio of Asti's own road: canon and civil law, and how to make a contract say something else later.

name: Physic under Tobie
blurb: Tobias Beventini knows what a crossbow bolt does and how to stop it doing more. Wounds heal faster.

name: Dyes and mordants
blurb: Woad, madder, kermes and the alum that fixes them. The trade beneath the whole of Bruges.

name: Greek, from a refugee of the City
blurb: Since Constantinople fell the Greeks teach anyone who pays. Trebizond opens to a merchant who speaks it.

name: Arabic and the Alexandrian trade
blurb: Enough to bargain in the Mamluk funduqs, and to know when you are being cheated.
